name: Adding — The Whole Hand
summary: With trust and comfort, fullness with the entire hand can feel deeply tender and pleasurable—not aggressive or 'porny' as some fear. It requires careful warmup, going one finger at a time with long breaks, using the thumb tuck.
detailed_description: Hand insertion carries judgment for some, who assume it's rough or pornographic; many find it the opposite—tender and loving when there's trust and comfort. The key is warmup: add one finger at a time, taking a long break after each so tissue can expand naturally before proceeding. The hand narrows by tucking the thumb into the palm (thumb tuck). Motion is minimal pulsing only—no thrusting.
stepwise_structure: 1. Establish trust and comfort first; this is tender, not aggressive, when done consensually.
3. Start with one finger; wait several minutes until fully comfortable.
4. Add the next finger only when ready, continuing gradually with long breaks between.
5. Tuck the thumb into the palm (thumb tuck) to narrow the hand as you progress.
6. Use minimal pulsing motions only—no thrusting—to avoid uncomfortable impacts.
safety_notes: Requires extended warmup—go one finger at a time with long breaks for tissue to expand.
Stop immediately if asked or if there's pain; this depends entirely on trust and consent.

key_technique.description: Tuck the thumb into the palm to narrow the hand; reach it via one-finger-at-a-time warmup with long breaks.
